decisions.statement: A value is wrapped in single quotes.
A single quote inside the value closes the quoting.
An escaped single quote follows the quoting.
The quoting opens again after the escaped single quote.
A character the shell expands is left for the shell to read as text.
An empty value is answered as a pair of quotes rather than as nothing.
Nothing here builds a command or runs a command.

definition: a value written into a shell command as one literal word
